title: Planet Coaster 2
provenance: Reported not launching by cgp9cvzk52-max (highball-db#115, 2026-09-18) on DXMT then D3DMetal, Apple M3 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, Highball 0.9.12: the game's own crash dialog at start. The working configuration comes from the Cellar project's published profile for this game (D3DMetal, Wine 11, MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1), playable there on an M5. Not run here.
notes: Direct3D 12 only (Cobra engine), so D3DMetal, and it needs a Wine 11 engine. The recipe carries the Cellar workaround, Metal's validation layer on, which stops a D3DMetal startup race that otherwise ends the game within seconds. Reported about 55 fps in the menu on an M5 there, with large parks CPU-bound under Rosetta. Denuvo, Steam must be online. Nothing measured here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash dialog at launch offering to send diagnostics to the developer
knownIssues.cause: DXMT has no Direct3D 12; and on the Wine 10 engines D3DMetal hits a startup race
knownIssues.fix: the planet-coaster-2 recipe: Wine 11 engine, D3DMetal, MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1 and MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_ERROR_MODE=nslog
